units.boundsAndLocations: centimetres in UE world axes except local mesh bounds and sizeM fields

measurementNotes: Structural envelope is the union of valid world AABBs for non-GroupActor members of Architecture1, BP PillarSet, BP Towers, Floor, Interior Walls, Railing, Stairs, SupportArchitecture and Walls. It includes elevated, overhanging and decorative geometry within those folders.
Actor boxes are geometry envelopes and cannot establish clear walkable dimensions. Component transforms are relative to their attach parents.
Assembly memberships describe selected actors unless identified as native Blueprint actors or editor GroupActors. Editor group member references were not exported.
Default mesh material references are sampled; queried instance overrides are recorded per component.

plateauRecommendation.basis: Reference-scale structural envelope plus planning allowance for shelf edges and connections. Terrain slopes, cliffs and outlying rocks beyond the shelf are separate.

entry_gate.kind: Blueprint with two flanking Blueprints; audit-defined collection
entry_gate.reuse: Reference the pack Blueprints and use an Ashen Keep Level Instance for the fixed shell after validating door clearance. Keep gameplay gate logic separate.

entry_forecourt.reuse: Reconstruct on 5 m bays. Keep center aisle clear and dress sides after gameplay blockout.

approach_first_flight.reuse: Duplicate one four-step-module flight into an Ashen Keep Level Instance or generate repeats from fixed rise/run and hand-place landings.

outer_wall_bay.reuse: Reconstruct with 7.5 m bay and story pitch. Hand place crown, corner and exposed buttress transitions.

interior_pillar_bays.reuse: Reference the pillar Blueprint and use paired 10 m stations. Rebuild floor, stairs and room envelope around play space.

elevated_deck_groups.reuse: Reference layout and recreate the deck with a purpose-built floor grid. Group bounds are returned by the editor and membership was not extracted.

secondary_gate.reuse: Reference mesh directly as a portal facade and build return walls and interaction separately.

round_tower.reuse: Reference Blueprint; adapt placement and verify playable shell requirements.

buttressed_round_tower.reuse: Reference Blueprint for a wall-to-tower junction; fit buttresses to the wall datum.

tall_square_tower.reuse: Reference Blueprint variants and set floor/bridge connections independently.

small_square_tower.reuse: Reference as a corner or rhythm tower.

skyline_landmark.kind: Scaled Blueprint actor despite SM_ object name
skyline_landmark.reuse: Use as silhouette reference. Build a controlled-scale landmark if playable interiors are needed.

bridge_large.reuse: Reference mesh directly; author matched end abutments, surface collision and rails as required.

bridge_small.reuse: Reference mesh directly for short link; verify deck endpoints and collision.

interior_stair.kind: Sampled loose static meshes; combined extent is sample coverage
interior_stair.reuse: Reconstruct at required floor elevations and verify player traversal, railing and blockers.
